description: The Restrictions section discharges its advice about INSERT timeouts by telling the reader to set `indexer.settings.scan_timeout` through the Index Settings REST API - a Query-statement page prescribing an Index Service setting to fix a Data-path timeout, with no explanation of the connection. The equivalent sentence on the Capella page stops at 'Ensure that the timeout is set to a reasonable value' and names no setting. Either the indexer scan timeout genuinely governs bulk-INSERT completion, in which case the page should say why and the Capella page is missing information, or the instruction was pasted in from a SELECT/index context and is wrong here.
